title: WindACT: wind turbine noise annoyance and nuisance in Ireland — materials and code
description: Research materials and analysis code from WindACT, a project at the Galway Sound Lab, University of Galway. Funded by the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland (SEAI) under RD&D Grant 25/RDD/1354.
